planned_arguments.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one complete, flat, opaque landscape 16:9 photographic editorial poster for a weekend houseplant market, ready for SNS. A photographic encounter between a modest plant for the home and an enveloping mature canopy expresses the pleasure of choosing a plant and watching it grow under everyday care.

Whole design: three unequal photographic encounters interlock diagonally, without borders, a shared grid or equal picture panels. At the lower left, an intimate descending row of small living nursery plants in subdued porcelain and unmarked terracotta pots is seen at pot height, with real soil, rims and naturally attached stems. Across the upper right, an immersive tightly cropped mature green canopy extends off the top and right edges. Between these scales, one closer crop clearly reveals a leaf joined by its petiole to its own stem and the rim of its actual pot. Distinguish the specimens; do not imply different species are one plant. Use convincing camera-specific focus, nuanced leaf veins, waxy highlights, tactile pottery, and soft cool daylight. These images are substantial and organize the composition. Their active leaf edges and the diagonal pot row open a continuous pale photographic seam for text; avoid a room wall made into a text board.

Type and reading route: the first copy entry is the strongest verbal anchor, a moderately large mature Korean serif with open counters and controlled stroke contrast, in two natural word-group lines beside the lower-left pot row. The second entry is a substantially smaller, lighter compact Latin companion immediately on the same axis. The canopy edge leads upward from this anchor into the slogan and broad explanation across the middle seam. Give the full explanation a roughly half-width continuous reading area, upright left alignment and three semantic lines as printed below. Reserve this area before scaling the photographs or title. Medium-weight Korean sans body with balanced rectangular syllables, generous counters, stable consonant/vowel proportions and clear word spaces; clean proportional Latin and lining numerals. At a 720-pixel-wide SNS reading assumption, aim for a comfortable body around 16 pixels, normal leading and sufficient contrast, not a miniature caption. This is a layout assumption, not a required output size.

At the terminal horizontal ledge of the explanation, the crop turns into the adjacent right-hand visit column. Keep the market name, date, hours and venue together there; continue with the access and care lines immediately below, then the conversational invitation and URL together. Make the date distinct but subordinate to the title. Let crop edges, proximity and this shared ledge connect the paragraph to the next useful information. No detached footer or four-corner scattering. Keep planar, crisp typesetting independent of photographic texture. Date and hour range dashes must have optically extended midline forms, distinct from short hyphens; preserve the literal punctuation, colons, middle dots, ampersand, periods, numeric baselines and meaningful word spaces.

Color and finish: cool natural green, charcoal type, subdued porcelain and clean pale photographic highlights. Keep believable botanical attachment, clear pot edges and coherent light across the unequal views. A composed photographic editorial image, not a passive solid/near-solid/split-field headline/date/information template with subordinate images, texture, font substitution or empty-room dressing. No tape material requirement. No mockup, comparison sheet, extra poster, logo, QR, watermark, labels, plant tags, incidental lettering or new copy.

Print only the following twelve entries, each exactly once. Line wrapping is flexible except that the title's two word groups and the explanation's three meaning groups below are the chosen design. Preserve every Korean/Latin letter, number, punctuation mark and word space:
집 안의
작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다.
재배자의 이야기를 듣고,
우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.
